title: Photography & Camera Gear Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=lightroom:photo) OR (index=personal sourcetype=flickr:photo)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="lightroom:photo","primary",sourcetype="flickr:photo","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from lightroom:photo and flickr:photo to see whether two photography feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `lightroom:photo` and `flickr:photo` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main photography data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
